meta.title: feat: add buffer pool for audio conversion
meta.body_summary: Implement a float32 buffer pool using sync.Pool for audio conversion, reducing memory allocations by 99.99% and improving performance by 3.97x according to benchmarks.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code produced a well-tested sync.Pool-based optimization with benchmarks; coderabbitai suggestions for modernization were applied before self-merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1291 changed lines, this is a medium-sized addition by absolute volume, mostly new pool and test files. The PR fits a standard feature performance PR that merged quickly after bot review suggestions were incorporated.

review_details.concern_detail: coderabbitai bot provided multiple suggestions to modernize benchmarks with b.Loop(), use proper infinity checks (math.IsInf), fix fuzz test state leakage, align range checks, and update documentation with actual benchmark numbers.
review_details.performance_claim: 3.97x faster conversion and 99.99% memory allocation reduction using float32 buffer pool.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Claude Code successfully implemented a sync.Pool-based buffer pool for audio conversion, a standard performance optimization in Go. The PR included thorough tests and benchmarks, but required maintenance feedback on idiomatic Go patterns (b.Loop, math.IsInf) to achieve merge quality.

detection_detail.code_reading: coderabbitai bot performed automated code review suggesting modernization of benchmarks, fuzz test improvements, and documentation updates.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes benchmark functions and clear before/after numbers; reproduction steps can be executed with `go test -bench`.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All bot suggestions were addressed in the final commit before merging, including switching to b.Loop(), using math.IsInf, fixing range consistency, and moving buffers slice inside fuzz function.

core_change_summary.description: Added Float32Pool using sync.Pool to myaudio package, integrated into convert16BitToFloat32 for standard buffer sizes, with initialization during BirdNET startup. Added comprehensive unit, fuzz, and benchmark tests, plus documentation.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files provide thorough validation and benchmarks; documentation captures performance impact.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (e17c1ba) introducing pool, integration, tests, and docs.
Linter fixes commit (829a10b) addressing switch statement and nolint.
Final refactor (9726223) modernizing benchmarks per bot suggestions, fixing fuzz issues, updating doc.

review_signals.summary: Provided walkthrough, identified code quality improvements, and suggested 9 actionable comments.
Suggested using b.Loop() instead of manual b.N loops, and avoiding direct benchmark function calls.
Recommended moving buffers slice inside fuzz function, using math.IsInf for infinity checks, and aligning range checks.
Suggested updating performance claims with actual benchmark results.
review_signals.action_taken: Documentation updated with measured improvements in commit 9726223.

collaboration_trajectory: Claude Code generated the initial float32 pool implementation with tests and benchmarks.
Coderabbit bot performed automated review, suggesting multiple code quality and benchmark improvements.
Maintainer (tphakala) applied all suggestions in a follow-up commit, then merged shortly after.
